references.text: Instruction to stay away from false accusations and not judge the innocent, which aligns with the principle of a fair judgment.
Prohibition against injustice in judgment, with a command to judge fairly - the same theme of a just legal decision.
Moses instructs judges to judge fairly between people, within the same context of legal justice.
Appointment of judges and a command for fair judgment without perverting justice - parallel to principles of the court system.
Procedure for trials where men have disputes, and punishment for false witnesses - a directly parallel situation.
Proverb about acquitting the guilty and condemning the righteous - the opposite of the correct principle in Deuteronomy.
Prophetic condemnation of those who acquit the guilty and deny the righteous their rights.
Authorities as God's servants to punish evil and reward good - a New Testament application of fair judgment.
